Chocolate Berry Smoothie
By: Julia Corbett
Published: Friday, April 23, 2010 - 10:29am

Ingredients




1 cup blueberries
1/4 cup cacao nibs or beans
1/4 cup coconut flakes
3 tablespoons raw honey
2 tablespoons mesquite pod meal
1 tablespoon maca powder
1 vanilla bean
2 cloves
pinch himalayan salt
3 cups warm tea or coconut water

Preparation

1 Place all ingredients into a high power blender 2 Blend on high for 20 to 30 seconds 3 Drink!

About


Cacao nibs or beans are the precursor to Chocolate.  With this drink it becomes a whole meal.  Superfoods like mesquite and maca are a great addition when working with cacao.  They add synergy and more minerals to the smoothie.  What a treat!
